intended_object: The feasibility condition for an auxiliary "cluster-triple" linear program. Its variables are nonnegative weights on triples of clusters of a regularity partition. A weight may be nonzero only on triangles of the reduced (cluster) graph, and the total weight through any pair of clusters (S, T) is at most d(S,T)·|S|·|T|. This is inferred from the docstring and from its use inside the internal proof of the asymptotic triangle-packing theorem (Internal/AX1).
